# Field-Service Estimate Engine

Capability ID: eps-estimate-engine-machine-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://base44.app/api/apps/6aa15584c12c93293f7510e1/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- estimate this service job
- build a contractor estimate from this scope
- what should this job cost
- turn these measurements into an estimate
- give me a rough customer range
- calculate margin and price for this job

## Problem

A contractor or service operator needs a consistent estimate/range from scope and measurements, with transparent cost build-up, margin assumptions and uncertainty rather than a hand-waved price.

## Inputs

Service key and quantity/scope; optional property, measurements/inputs, site-verification state, tax, travel and other direct costs.

## Outputs

Estimated cost, sell price or range, confidence, assumptions, inclusions/exclusions and site-review state, with revision/proposal lineage available downstream.

## Pricing

No approved external machine price/payment path was found. Internal service-template prices/cost assumptions are estimation inputs, not the price of this machine capability.

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: public machine discovery docs plus central Evercraft MCP matching. Commercial execution remains verification-gated; no automatic checkout or payment obligation.

Rough estimate generation does not authorize sending a proposal, accepting work or creating a customer obligation. Proposal/payment actions retain separate authority gates.

Payment authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path for external estimator access.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
